text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, it seems I am rather 
fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Setting aside where we draw the line for 
'okay,' as long as you're conscious of it, 
maybe we ought to treat it as an issue."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, there is still so much research 
and so many experiments left to do...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What am I going to do about this 
lethargy?

Perhaps out of exhaustion, Agnes Tachyon 
keeps letting out deep sighs... It might 
be wise to reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule.
